goal: Prevent disk read errors and index corruptions from appearing as missing transactions
Ensure callers and node operators are properly alerted to underlying disk failures
reviewability: Ready for review now as the required rebase is mechanical
agreement: Support for separating unexpected I/O failures from missing transactions (musaHaruna, yuvicc)
Resolved objection regarding incorrect error message when querying pruned blocks (yuvicc)
Resolved suggestion regarding test cleanup on unexpected exceptions (musaHaruna)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because index corruptions and disk failures are no longer silently treated as missing data
Protects node operators by surfacing storage integrity problems rather than returning bad answers

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because getrawtransaction stops falsely reporting confirmed transactions as missing during disk errors
Protects downstream applications from making invalid assumptions about transaction existence
